description: Enrich bulletin data with severity scoring, error categorization, and port extraction

script.source: if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('Address already in use')) { ctx.errorCategory = 'PORT_CONFLICT'; } else if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('OutOfMemoryError') || ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('heap')) { ctx.errorCategory = 'MEMORY_ERROR'; } else if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('Connection refused') || ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('timeout')) { ctx.errorCategory = 'CONNECTION_ERROR'; } else if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('Invalid') || ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('validation')) { ctx.errorCategory = 'VALIDATION_ERROR'; } else if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('DistributedMapCacheServer')) { ctx.errorCategory = 'CACHE_SERVER_ERROR'; } else { ctx.errorCategory = 'GENERAL_ERROR'; }
